searchText: Can you help me with `eof.Container()` in execution-spec-tests? How to set the section type? I can see there is `auto_code_inputs_outputs` but no idea how this is activated. Ok, I've found it : `Section.Code(Op.STOP, code_outputs=NON_RETURNING_SECTION)`. What does `fix(fw)` mean?
